mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metric_config (metric_name, description, source_table, field, aggregation, group_by, filter_condition, sort_rule, enabled, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{metricName}, #{description}, #{sourceTable}, #{field}, #{aggregation}, #{groupBy}, #{filterCondition}, #{sortRule}, #{enabled}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE metric_config SET metric_name = #{metricName}, description = #{description}, source_table = #{sourceTable}, field = #{field}, aggregation = #{aggregation}, group_by = #{groupBy}, filter_condition = #{filterCondition}, sort_rule = #{sortRule}, enabled = #{enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE metric_config SET version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metric_config ORDER BY created_at DESC
